summary: Verified BUG 1 (METAS visibility) and BUG 2 (capture attr removed) fixes. All 9 backend pytest cases pass. Frontend E2E: created monthly goal appeared in both Metas dialog list AND dashboard GoalsCard row (Ano inteiro default). Delete flow via AlertDialog works. File inputs sale-ai-file-input and import-ai-file-input have no 'capture' attribute and accept images+pdf+xlsx+csv. Backend /api/sales/extract-one responsive. End state: 20 sales, 0 goals (clean).
critical_code_review_comments: list_goals correctly keeps annual goals visible when month filter is applied (g.month in (None, month))
GoalsDialog uses AlertDialog for delete confirmation — tests must click 'Remover' button (not window.confirm)
test_credentials: Master Bearer qa_session_vinicius_001 (also valid as cookie session_token)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Both bug fixes verified working. Goals API returns annual+monthly when no month param (bug 1 fixed). File inputs have no capture attr (bug 2 fixed). Test file /app/backend/tests/test_goals_bug.py reusable for regression. Env year is 2026, dashboard defaults to 'Ano inteiro'. Cleanup responsibility respected (0 goals end state).
rca of the issue: Bug 1 root cause: previous list_goals filtered goals by exact month equality even when month param was None, hiding monthly goals from the dashboard default view. Fix (confirmed): only apply month filter when month is not None, allowing annual (month=None) + monthly to coexist. Bug 2 root cause: capture='environment' attribute on file inputs forced mobile camera. Fix (confirmed): attribute removed; accept list expanded.
